"""Independently check archived bytes, denominators and frozen accounting."""
import base64
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import math
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
DEST = Path('/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit/docs/experiments')


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def checked(ref):
    path = DEST / ref.get('artifact', ref.get('path', ''))
    assert sha(path) == ref['sha256'], path
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


policy = json.loads((ROOT / 'matched-policy-v4.json').read_text())
tasks = {t['task_id']: t for t in json.loads((ROOT / 'matched-tasks-v2.json').read_text())['tasks']}
binding = json.loads((ROOT / 'execution-binding-v2.json').read_text())
assert all(sha(p) == h for p, h in binding['files'].items())
prior = json.loads((ROOT / 'pre-results-tracked-artifacts.json').read_text())
assert all(sha(DEST.parent.parent / p) == h for p, h in prior.items())
execution = json.loads((DEST / 'codegraph_matched_execution_v2.json').read_text())
assessment = json.loads((DEST / 'codegraph_matched_assessment_v2.json').read_text())
assert execution['status'] == 'model_execution_complete_pending_grading'
assert len(execution['workflows']) == 12
assert len(execution['read_only_tasks']) == 48
assert all(r['source_bytes_preserved'] is True for r in execution['read_only_tasks'])
assert all(p['sdk_terminal_success'] for r in execution['workflows'] for p in r['phases'])
assert sum(len(r['phases']) for r in execution['workflows']) == 60
assert sum(len(r['sessions']) for r in execution['workflows']) == 24
tokens, estimates, connected = 0, 0.0, 0
for workflow in execution['workflows']:
    for session in workflow['sessions']:
        assert session['closed'] and session['usage_complete']
        assert session['actual_init']['model'] == 'claude-opus-5-5'
        assert session['actual_init']['apiKeySource'] == 'none'
        tokens += session['normalized_tokens']
        estimates += session['sdk_estimate_usd']
        if workflow['workflow']['arm'] != 'native':
            assert session['actual_init']['mcp_servers'] == [{'name': 'study', 'status': 'connected', 'source': 'dynamic'}]
            connected += 1
assert tokens == execution['normalized_recorded_tokens'] == 9389337
assert math.isclose(estimates, execution['sdk_estimate_usd'], abs_tol=1e-10)
assert connected == 18
manifest = json.loads((DEST / 'codegraph_matched_v2_capture_manifest.json').read_text())
archives = {}
for ref in manifest['workflows']:
    archived = checked(ref)
    idx = archived['receipt_projection']['workflow']['workflow_index']
    archives[idx] = archived
    assert sha(archived['original_receipt']) == archived['original_receipt_sha256']
    for part in archived['phase_observations'].values():
        checked(part)
    checked(archived['source_snapshots'])
    checked(archived['original_tool_inputs'])
native_files = 0
for row in execution['native_grading']['original_files']:
    for item in row['files']:
        payloads = [checked(part) for part in item['parts']]
        payloads.sort(key=lambda p: p['part'])
        assert [p['part'] for p in payloads] == list(range(len(payloads)))
        encoded = b''.join(base64.b64decode(p['base64_bytes']) for p in payloads)
        assert all(p['content_encoding'] == 'gzip+base64' for p in payloads)
        raw = gzip.decompress(encoded)
        assert len(raw) == item['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == item['sha256']
        native_files += 1
grades = execution['native_grading']['summary']
assert len(grades) == 12
selected_native_outcomes = []
for grade in grades:
    assert grade['status'] == 'graded' and grade['sdk_terminal_success']
    result = grade['native_result']
    assert result['resolved'] is True
    report = result['native_report'][result['instance_id']]
    assert report['patch_successfully_applied'] and report['resolved']
    for tier, outcomes in report['tests_status'].items():
        assert outcomes['failure'] == []
        selected_native_outcomes.append({'workflow_index': grade['workflow']['workflow_index'], 'tier': tier, 'success': len(outcomes['success']), 'failure': 0})
reviews = []
for ref in assessment['assessment_artifacts'].values():
    case = checked(ref)
    for row in case['reviews']:
        archived = archives[row['workflow_index']]
        phase = next(p for p in archived['receipt_projection']['phases'] if p['kind'] == row['kind'])
        answer = phase['result']['result']
        assert hashlib.sha256(answer.encode()).hexdigest() == row['answer_sha256']
        assert [c['criterion'] for c in row['criteria']] == tasks[row['task_id']]['acceptance']['all_required']
        assert all(f['quote'] in answer for f in row['findings'])
        assert row['sdk_terminal_success'] and row['read_only_source_preserved']
        expected = False if any(c['met'] is False for c in row['criteria']) or row['serious_error'] else None if any(c['met'] is None for c in row['criteria']) else True
        assert row['accepted'] is expected
        for anchor in row['source_evidence']:
            assert anchor['source_evidence_id'] in case['source_evidence']
        reviews.append(row)
assert len(reviews) == 48 and len({(r['workflow_index'], r['kind']) for r in reviews}) == 48
assert sum(len(r['criteria']) for r in reviews) == 160
assert sum(r['accepted'] is True for r in reviews) == 34
assert sum(r['accepted'] is False for r in reviews) == 14
for workflow in assessment['workflows']:
    expected = workflow['observed_seconds'] + sum(max(0, t['frozen_deadline_seconds'] - t['observed_seconds']) for t in workflow['tasks'] if t['accepted'] is False)
    assert math.isclose(workflow['penalized_seconds'], expected, abs_tol=1e-9)
for arm, summary in assessment['arm_summary'].items():
    rows = [r for r in assessment['workflows'] if r['workflow']['arm'] == arm]
    assert summary['accepted'] == sum(t['accepted'] is True for r in rows for t in r['tasks'])
    assert summary['serious_error_tasks'] == sum(t['serious_error'] for r in rows for t in r['tasks'])
    assert math.isclose(summary['penalized_seconds'], sum(r['penalized_seconds'] for r in rows), abs_tol=1e-9)
maximum = max(assessment['arm_summary'][a]['accepted'] for a in ['native', 'serena', 'codegraph'])
eligible = [a for a in ['native', 'serena', 'codegraph'] if assessment['arm_summary'][a]['accepted'] == maximum and assessment['arm_summary'][a]['serious_error_tasks'] == 0 and assessment['arm_summary'][a]['unassessable'] == 0]
assert maximum == 13 and not eligible
assert assessment['frozen_gate']['outcome'] == 'insufficient_evidence'
new_files = [p for p in DEST.glob('codegraph*.json') if str(p.relative_to(DEST.parent.parent)) not in prior]
for path in new_files:
    json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert path.stat().st_size < 500 * 1024, path
value = {'recorded_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'scope': 'Post-run archive/accounting verification, not a new model/native attempt or source adjudication.',
    'checks': {'frozen_inputs_unchanged': len(binding['files']), 'preceding_tracked_artifacts_unchanged': len(prior),
        'sdk_tasks_complete': 60, 'sessions_closed_with_final_usage': 24, 'optional_sessions_connected': connected,
        'read_only_source_preserved': 48, 'fresh_source_reviews': len(reviews), 'frozen_criterion_applications': 160,
        'native_repairs_resolved': 12, 'native_original_files_byte_reconstructed': native_files,
        'new_json_parse_and_size_checks': len(new_files), 'accepted_task_and_penalty_totals_match': True, 'baseline_eligibility_matches_frozen_rule': True},
    'selected_native_outcomes': selected_native_outcomes,
    'implementation': {'sha256': sha(__file__), 'text': Path(__file__).read_text()}}
path = DEST / 'codegraph_matched_v2_validation.json'
assert not path.exists()
path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(value['checks']))
